Crosstalk bullhorns are the equivalent of the open-end telephone cords that connect two stations on a telephone network. As with many things in networking, their use falls well below their potential benefits.
Bullhorns were first introduced by Bell Labs sometime in 1880 as "Bell horn for connection to central offices" (Bell 1985). The first commercial use was in 1959 when telephone operators used them to pass messages directly between distant exchange nodes (Rush 1986).
The term "bullhorn" applies particularly to use in telephone exchanges where it is a device to speak to staff on other telephones within the same geographic area without broadcasting the information to the entire office by transmitting it through a carrier-current circuit (Greenfield 1991). Chedda Bongô là thành viên của chế độ Benin (Beninois). Nước Benin được thành lập vào ngày 30 tháng 12 năm 1904 bởi Henry Victor Duvergier de Hauranne (Hữu nghị) sau cuộc chiến của Pháp thuộc Liên Xô (dưới thời đế chế) và Hoàng đế Benin (dưới quyền), Samory Ture..
